repos.name: mikehasa/agentacct
repos.description: See what your coding agents did and what it cost. Breaks each task down into work steps — tools used, files changed, tests run, time and tokens spent. Local-first dashboard for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and more. No login, no telemetry.
repos.one_liner: A local-first observability dashboard for tracking the performance, token usage, and cost of coding agents.
bullets: Built in Python with a focus on local-first data storage and privacy.
Provides granular visibility into agent workflows, including file changes, tool execution, and test results.
Calculates real-time financial metrics like token consumption and time-to-completion per task.
Designed to integrate with popular coding agents like Claude Code and Codex to audit development efficiency.
repos.img_alt: agentacct tui — live usage, cost, provider rate-limit bars, and recent sessions with per-session weekly-plan-cost estimates
repos.img2_alt: agentacct tui session detail — the per-step work ledger with pass/fail check evidence and a weekly-plan-cost estimate

repos.name: simonlin1212/vibe-astock
repos.description: A 股短线复盘看板：涨停池·连板梯队·龙虎榜·板块资金一屏看完，赚钱效应/晋级率/梯队断层/情绪周期等派生指标纯计算直出（不经过 AI），AI 只把数据串成能读的盘面研判。全本地运行，可用 Claude/Codex 订阅免 API key。| A-share short-term daily-review dashboard: derived sentiment metrics computed locally, AI only writes the narrative. No API key needed.
repos.one_liner: A local-running A-share market sentiment and short-term trading dashboard that combines deterministic financial metrics with AI-driven analysis.
bullets: Uses a hybrid architecture: deterministic calculation for market metrics and LLM-based synthesis for narrative reporting.
Features specialized modules for tracking limit-up pools, liquidity flows, and market sentiment cycles.
Operates entirely locally to ensure data privacy and zero-cost API usage for market monitoring.
Ideal for quantitative traders needing a high-level overview of Chinese market dynamics without relying on cloud-based financial platforms.

repos.name: Flaminis/Dalaran
repos.description: Dalaran — Apache-2.0, robotics-first visualization and data infrastructure for multimodal time-series. ROS 2 native, reads existing .rrd recordings. A hard fork of Rerun.
repos.one_liner: A robotics-first visualization and data infrastructure tool for multimodal time-series data, built as a high-performance fork of Rerun.
bullets: Written in Rust, optimized for high-throughput ingestion and visualization of time-series data.
Native ROS 2 support allows for seamless integration into existing robotics and automated data pipelines.
Designed to handle complex, multi-sensor data streams with low latency, making it suitable for high-frequency trading backtesting or sensor fusion.
Provides a robust framework for replaying and analyzing historical data recordings (.rrd files) with advanced visual inspection.
